remarks: Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac, this beautifully maintained home has been lovingly cared for by the same family for many years. Its inviting warmth and ideal location make it a rare find in one of Stamford's most convenient neighborhoods. Just a few blocks from the popular Newfield Green Shopping Center, with easy access to bus lines, Sterling Farms Golf Course, the JCC, Italian Center, and the Springdale Train Station. Downtown Stamford, the main train station, and I-95 are all just minutes away. Inside, sunlight highlights gleaming hardwood floors throughout (even under the carpets). The spacious living and dining room combination features a charming wood-burning fireplace - perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The updated kitchen includes an adjacent laundry room and an oversized pantry offering exceptional storage. The primary bedroom suite features a full bath with a stall shower. A beautiful backyard with a private patio provides the perfect setting for outdoor dining and gatherings. The large unfinished basement, with high ceilings, offers tremendous potential to create a playroom, gym, home office, workshop, or creative studio. A wonderful opportunity to own a truly well-loved home in a desirable, convenient Stamford location.
